content.title: Soitec appoints Infineon executive Laurent Remont as CEO
content.summary: Semiconductor wafer maker Soitec has appointed Laurent Remont as its new chief ​executive officer, to replace Pierre Barnabe from April, ‌the French company said on Thursday.  Shares of Soitec were up 9.4% at ‌0826 GMT, at the top of the SBF 120 index of Paris' most traded equities.  "On paper, this looks like a very good hire for Soitec," Bernstein analyst Aleksander Peterc ⁠said in a note ‌to clients.

content.title: STMicroelectronics shares jump 7% on report Apple in talks over LiDAR sensors
